name: burpsuite-mcp-bridge
description: Production-oriented Burp Suite MCP bridge for proxy traffic triage, replay, logger-like tool capture, and request/response automation across WSL and Windows clients.

interface.shortDescription: Bridge Burp Suite traffic, replay, and rewrite workflows into MCP clients and IDEs
interface.longDescription: Expose Burp Suite proxy and internal HTTP tool traffic to MCP clients over standard transports. Supports low-noise polling, history search, replay with request mutation, request/response rewrite rules, Repeater handoff, logger-like capture, and exportable evidence across WSL and Windows setups.
defaultPrompt: Use BurpSuite MCP Bridge to summarize recent proxy traffic and identify the login chain.
Use BurpSuite MCP Bridge to inspect Burp history for upload endpoints and replay a candidate request with a harmless header mutation.
Use BurpSuite MCP Bridge to export the exact request/response pair that proves a finding, then create a temporary response rewrite rule for verification.
